items.title: Israel orders detention without charge for journalist who exposed prison abuse
items.summary: Samer Khuwaira was rearrested three weeks after telling Haaretz about starvation and medical neglect during his previous nine months in Israeli custody

ai.sum: Israel ordered administrative detention without charge for journalist Samer Khuwaira, rearrested after he described prison abuse.

items.summary: Uluslararası Af Örgütü, İsrail'in işgali altındaki Gazze Şeridi'nde Filistinlilere yönelik sürdürdüğü soykırımın kadınlar ve kız çocukları üzerindeki etkilerine ilişkin hazırladığı 135 sayfalık yeni raporu kamuoyuyla paylaştı.

items.title: Türk warns of widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians
items.summary: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Wednesday warned of a widening risk of further atrocity crimes by Israel against Palestinians, saying violence in the occupied West Bank in recent months has heightened existential fears.

items.title: Eisenkot says coalition deal 'will happen' ahead of fresh talks with Likud
items.summary: "After a 40-minute break, we're getting back to work on this with full vigor, and it will happen," the Yashar chairman said, referring to the coalition negotiations.
